test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A solid metal cylinder of 12 cm height and 7 cm radius is melted and recast into two cones in the proportion of 1 : 2 (volume), keeping the height 12 cm . What would be the percentage change in the flat surface area before and after [use pi=(22)/(7)] ?
solution:
**Given:**

Height of cylinder (h) = 12 cm

Radius of cylinder (r) = 7 cm

Volume ratio of cones = 1 : 2

Height of both cones = 12 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

Volume of cone = (1/3)πr²h

**Calculation:**

Volume of the cylinder:

⇒ 22/7 × 7 × 7 × 12 = 1848 cm³

flat surface area of cylinder = 2 πr² = 2 × 22/7 × 7 × 7 =308 cm²

Now,

Volume of 1st cone : Volume of 2nd cube = 1 : 2

So, Volume of 1st cone = 1/3 × 1848 = 616 cm³

Volume of 2nd cone = 2/3 × 1848 = 1232 cm³

Now,

Volume of 1st cone = 616

⇒ 1/3 × 22/7 × (r₁)2 × 12 = 616

⇒ (r1)2 = 49 

⇒ r₁ = 7 cm

So, flat surface area = π(r1)² = 22/7 × 7 × 7 = 154 cm²

Volume of 2nd cone = 1232 cm3

⇒ 1/3 × 22/7 × (r2)2 × 12 = 1232

⇒ (r2)2 = 49 × 2

⇒ r₂ = 7√2 cm

So, flat surface area = π(r2)2 = 22/7 × 7√2 × 7√2 = 308 cm²

Thus, total flat surface of cones = 154 + 308 = 462 cm²

So, Percentage change = (462 - 308) / 308 × 100

⇒ 154/308 × 100 = 100/2 = 50%

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
